lessonTitle: Adding fractions with the same denominator

lessonKeywords.description: the number below the line in a fraction; it shows how many equal parts the whole is divided into
the number above the line in a fraction

keyLearningPoints.keyLearningPoint: When adding fractions with the same denominator, add the numerators.

misconceptionsAndCommonMistakes.misconception: Pupils add the denominators as well as the numerators.
misconceptionsAndCommonMistakes.response: Use a bar model to show that the size of the parts does not change.

pupilLessonOutcome: I can add fractions with the same denominator.

teacherTips.teacherTip: Use fraction walls so pupils can see the parts.
